_doc: Gate A corpus. Four arms per item, same gold intent.  arm1_zh_raw = deictic Chinese as spoken.  arm2_zh_grounded = Chinese with referents resolved (what E4B would emit if it answered in Chinese).  arm3_en_grounded = English with referents resolved (what E4B would emit if instructed to answer in English) -- this is the model's native domain.  arm4_en_raw = the untouched routelet holdout line, as an upper-bound control: if this arm does not score near the published accuracy, the harness itself is broken and no other arm's number means anything.
